headline: Argentine Agro Bodies Launch Labor Certification for Soy and Beef Exports
summary: Argentine agricultural union Uatre and export platform Visec introduced a labor verification certificate presented at the Buenos Aires Grain Exchange to certify farm working conditions and comply with international export standards.
why: Argentina is one of the world's leading exporters of soybean products and beef. Meeting international labor and traceability criteria is vital for maintaining market access to Europe and North America.

impacts.name: Argentine Agribusiness
impacts.why: Labor compliance frameworks protect market access for beef, soy, and timber shipments.
